description: This file implements the HmacSerializable class, which provides serialization and deserialization functionalities with HMAC-based integrity checks, for secure data handling within the Android Open Source Project. It includes methods for size calculation, serialization, deserialization, and appending additional authenticated data.

classes.name: HmacSerializable
classes.description: A class that provides secure serialization and deserialization of data with HMAC for integrity, wrapping another Serializable object.

methods.name: size_t SerializedSize() const
methods.description: Calculates the total size in bytes of the serialized HmacSerializable object.

methods.name: uint8_t * Serialize(uint8_t * buf,const uint8_t * end) const
methods.description: Serializes the object into a buffer, including generating an HMAC for integrity.

methods.name: bool Deserialize(const uint8_t ** buf_ptr,const uint8_t * end)
methods.description: Deserializes the object from a buffer, verifying the HMAC for data integrity.

methods.name: std::optional<std::vector<uint8_t>> AppendAad(const uint8_t * sensitive,size_t sensitive_size) const
methods.description: Appends additional authenticated data (AAD) to the serialized data if provided.

methods.name: HmacSerializable(TpmResourceManager & resource_manager,std::function<TpmObjectSlot (TpmResourceManager &)> signing_key_fn,uint32_t digest_size,Serializable * wrapped,const Serializable * aad)
